zh: 画面中央有一条贯穿上下的深色长笔画。
上部结构有数个短突笔和一个浅色开口。
中部有一处宽大的深色交叉，打断中央长笔画。
下部形成较大的圆钝外框，内部留有浅色区域。
下缘不规则，左侧可见短横向外伸笔画。
下部浅色区域内可见一个孤立的小深色痕迹。
en: A tall dark stroke runs through the center of the image.
The upper group has several short projections and a pale opening.
A broad dark crossing interrupts the central vertical stroke.
The lower group forms a large rounded enclosure with a pale interior.
The lower edge is uneven, with a short horizontal extension at the left.
A small isolated dark mark appears inside the lower pale area.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
